Score a census forecast against observed census

Source: R/score_census.R
score_census.Rd

Joins on (location, target_end_date) and scores via scoringutils::score().

Usage

score_census(census_fc, truth)

Arguments

census_fc

Hubverse-format census forecast (output of fcast_census()).

truth

Hubverse target-data tibble of observed census (target_end_date, target, location, observation).

Value

A scoringutils scored tibble.
